How many times per second a display shows a new picture right now, in Hz. A rate with a fraction, like 59.94, is rounded to 60. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.
@param display  The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays).
@returns The refresh rate in Hz, or 0 if the display does not exist.
@gap A display that does not tell its refresh rate is taken to have 60 Hz.
@gap A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
